verdict.rationale: Source connections are documented as automatically syncing data, which implies recurring sync jobs, and webhooks report sync completion. Syncs can also be triggered from Pipedream workflows, so recurring orchestration appears to depend on an external automation tool rather than a native scheduler. Missing for 10: a documented native scheduler or cron configuration for syncs or workflows, user-controlled sync frequency settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring job behavior.
